text: CHIEF CORRECTION AND RULINGS. (a) CORRECTION TO THIS BEAD: the chief wrote that an unclassified unit is an ordinary path. The scout read the source - classes is graph.ordered.map(id -> classify) and classify is TOTAL - so classes.get(u.id)==None is an INVARIANT BREAK, not a routine case. It still needs an adversarial regression; it is not a routine leak. The other two conditions stand. (b) VOCABULARY AUTHORIZED: MissingReason.Custom(namespace, label), with package-level constants and codec round-trip tests, mirroring UndefinedReason.Custom and MalformedReason.Custom. Reasons: design-contract rule 2 already prescribes Custom(namespace,label) as THE escape hatch for extending a closed vocabulary; three new generic cases would force codec and law scope on every module carrying a MissingReason in order to express reasons that are not general (ClassifiedUninterpretable is built on UnitClass, which is interview vocabulary, and promoting it would pollute the portable enum with one module's ontology); and the namespace keeps aggregate reporting groupable. CONSTRAINT: a Custom reason that DUPLICATES a generic one is a review failure - Custom("interview","provider-abstained") is forbidden while ProviderAbstained exists. Not mechanically enforceable; goes in the review checklist here and for every later use. (c) THE OTHER UnitClass CASES (Metacognitive, Evaluative, Repair, TaskCommentary, etc.) ARE INELIGIBLE - not Missing, not observed(0.0). Missing means the question applies and we could not answer; Ineligible means it does not apply. 'How specific is this episodic detail' is incoherent for a task comment: a participant saying they are rambling is not a low-specificity memory, it is not a memory. The payoff is coverage: Ineligible leaves the denominator, so specificity coverage becomes observed-over-eligible-episodic rather than observed-over-everything-said - under current code a talkative participant with many task comments is scored as producing a great deal of maximally unspecific content, a claim about them generated entirely by our bucketing. Habitual (0.15) and GeneralFact (0.05) are DIFFERENT and stay observed: per the design record those denote the episode at reduced specificity, so the question applies and has an answer.
